success.title: Application Submitted Successfully!
success.description: Thank you for applying to the MA in Natural Resource Management and Sustainable Development. Your application dossier and attached documents have been submitted to the admissions cell at xinrmsocialcentre50@gmail.com. You can download your official application spreadsheet or print your signed summary below.

sameAddress.label: Permanent Address same as Present Address

category.label: Category
category.note: Please Note: Keep a recent self-attested copy of the relevant certificate ready for admission verification.

additional.label: Additional Academic / Professional Qualifications (Optional)
additional.placeholder: List any diplomas, computer certifications, GIS training, etc.

honors.label: Prizes, Honors, Scholarships or Awards received
honors.placeholder: List any academic prizes, merit awards, scholarships received

orgName.label: Organization Name & Address
orgName.placeholder: Company / NGO / Institute name with city

reference.label: Professional Reference
reference.placeholder: Name, Designation, Contact Number / Email of Supervisor

responsibility.label: Job Responsibilities & Key Achievements
responsibility.placeholder: Describe your daily roles, projects managed, and notable accomplishments

hobbies.label: Hobbies & Interests
hobbies.placeholder: e.g. Reading, Trekking, Organic Gardening, Photography

extracurriculars_1.label: Extracurricular Activity 1
extracurriculars_1.placeholder: e.g. College NSS / NCC, Sports Team Captain, Environmental Club

extracurriculars_2.label: Extracurricular Activity 2
extracurriculars_2.placeholder: e.g. Debate, Youth Parliament, Community Volunteering

source.label: How did you find out about this course?

documents_section.title: Mandatory Document Uploads (Required for Admission)
documents_section.description: All applicants must upload legible, self-attested digital copies of the 7 mandatory documents below (Max 5MB each, PDF or Image).

photo.label: 1. Passport Size Photograph *
photo.hint: Recent passport photo with clear face view (JPG/PNG)

intent.label: Desire to Pursue this Course (Statement of Intent)
intent.note: Please articulate your motivation and passion for joining the M.A. in Natural Resource Management & Sustainable Development (Minimum 50 characters).

career.label: Career Utilization Intent
career.note: How do you intend to utilize this degree and field training in your future career? (Minimum 50 characters).

declaration.title: Declaration by the Candidate
declaration.text: hereby declare that the information furnished in this Application Form is complete and true. I have also noted that I will be called for tests and/or personal interview based on the information provided therein, as above. I also agree that the institute has the right to cancel my candidature, if the institute finds that any information provided therein is incomplete, false or misleading or ineligibility being detected before or after the admission.
declaration.accept: I accept and confirm the declaration above.

physical_apply.title: Prefer applying with physical documents?
physical_apply.description: You can download the official application form as a DOCX document, fill it out manually with your attached photo and certificates, and submit it directly at our campus.
